name: Parcel Sorter
blurb: Sort, scan and stack the neighbourhood's parcels. You'll see how shipping really works.

perk.desc: 15% off PostPoint drop-off shipping for your own parcels.

lines: Three hundred parcels, one broken scanner. Dara fixes it with a paperclip.
You learn which box sizes the couriers hate. Useful.
A seller drops off twenty parcels with no labels. You feel their pain.
Evening cut-off: everything out by 19:00, and it is.
